verifier: root orchestrator, independent repeat after code-build checks

commands.name: build
commands.command: for h in claude-code opencode codex copilot zcode; do python3 tools/render.py "$h" || exit; done

commands.name: test
commands.command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tools && bash -n install.sh && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist/)"
